original_paragraph.ITC Measurements: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC)16–18 measurements were performed on the Nano-ITC III calorimeter (Calorimetry Sciences Corp., USA). Human carbonic anhydrase I (hCAI) and bovine carbonic anhydrase II (bCAII) were purchased from, ‘Sigma’. Binding measurements were performed at pH 7.0 in 50 mM tris–chloride buffer containing 50 mM NaCl. A typical titration consisted of 25 injections of a tested compound (10 μl per injection) at 3 min intervals into the sample cell containing protein sample.
original_paragraph.Figure 1 caption: Figure 1. Typical isothermal titration calorimetry curves of carbonic anhydrase binding to compounds (4a binding to bCAII). a—raw data (power (P) dependence on time), b—integrated data (enthalpy (ΔH) evolved per injection).
